// coding-misk · Insert Coin
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(150/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 25], ['Crescendo 2', 35], ['Insert coin', 2], ['Livello 1', 8], ['Livello 1 B', 8], ['Boss', 8], ['Bonus', 4], ['Livello 2', 8], ['Game over', 2]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 150, 'Crescendo 2': 150, 'Insert coin': 150, 'Livello 1': 150, 'Livello 1 B': 150, 'Boss': 156, 'Bonus': 150, 'Livello 2': 152, 'Game over': 152}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!25 0!75>"  // Crescendo · 25 bars · 150 BPM · A · Am
const section2 = "<0!25 1!35 0!40>"  // Crescendo 2 · 35 bars · 150 BPM · A · Am F G Am
const section3 = "<0!60 1!2 0!38>"  // Insert coin · 2 bars · 150 BPM · A · Am F G Am
const section4 = "<0!62 1!8 0!30>"  // Livello 1 · 8 bars · 150 BPM · A · Am F G Am
const section5 = "<0!70 1!8 0!22>"  // Livello 1 B · 8 bars · 150 BPM · A · Am F G Am
const section6 = "<0!78 1!8 0.5 0!13>"  // Boss · 8 bars · 156 BPM · A · Am Am Am A#
const section7 = "<0!86 0.5 1!3 0!10>"  // Bonus · 4 bars · 150 BPM · A · Am F G Am · fades in over 1 bars
const section8 = "<0!90 1!8 0!2>"  // Livello 2 · 8 bars · 152 BPM · B · Bm G A Bm
const section9 = "<0!98 1!2>"  // Game over · 2 bars · 152 BPM · B · Bm G A Bm

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-25 · pattern C~2
// Drums · YamahaRX5
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("YamahaRX5").gain(0.9).lpf(2000).distort(0.4).distortvol(.5).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [sd ~ ~ ~] ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("YamahaRX5").gain(0.68).lpf(2000).distort(0.4).distortvol(.5).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] [hh ~ ~ ~] ~ [hh ~ ~ ~]").bank("YamahaRX5").gain(0.45).lpf(2000).distort(0.4).distortvol(.5).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Crescendo 2 · bars 26-60 · pattern C~2
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("YamahaRX5").gain(0.9).lpf(2000).distort(0.4).distortvol(.5).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("kick")

$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] [hh ~ hh ~] [hh ~ ~ ~] [hh ~ hh ~]").bank("YamahaRX5").gain("<0.2 0.4>").lpf(2000).distort(0.4).distortvol(.5).mask("<1 [1 0]>").mask(section3).velocity(section3).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
